title_en: RABBIT — CHANG'E & THE FAR SIDE OF THE MOON
description: An interactive field guide to China's robotic lunar programme, 2007–2024: orbit, land, return. Chang'e 1–3 and the Yutu rover, why the Moon always shows us one face, the Queqiao relay at the Earth–Moon L2 point and why it has to fly a halo orbit, the first landing on the far side (Chang'e 4), and the sample returns of Chang'e 5 and Chang'e 6 — 2-billion-year-old basalt and the first rocks from the far side.
og: Tidal locking, the L2 relay geometry, a lunar ascent calculator and the youngest Moon rocks ever dated — the Chang'e programme, interactive and sourced.
brand: RABBIT — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
